doc: TodoMVC, as a dynamic component: the whole canonical list in one bundle.

components.name: TodoMvc
components.doc: The canonical todo list: add, tick, edit in place, delete, filter, and clear what is done.

messageDocs.name: addOnEnter
messageDocs.doc: Add the draft when the key was Enter.

messageDocs.name: typeDraft
messageDocs.doc: Hold what is being typed into the new-task box.

messageDocs.name: toggleAt
messageDocs.doc: Tick or untick the task at an index.

messageDocs.name: removeAt
messageDocs.doc: Delete the task at an index.

messageDocs.name: toggleAll
messageDocs.doc: Tick everything, or untick it if it all is.

messageDocs.name: startEdit
messageDocs.doc: Open the task at an index for editing.

messageDocs.name: typeEdit
messageDocs.doc: Hold what is being typed into the open row.

messageDocs.name: commitEdit
messageDocs.doc: Keep the edit; an emptied row is deleted.

messageDocs.name: cancelEdit
messageDocs.doc: Abandon the edit and keep what was there.

messageDocs.name: countLeft
messageDocs.doc: How many tasks are not done, as a sentence.

messageDocs.name: matchesFilter
messageDocs.doc: Whether the current filter lets a row through.

fields.name: items
fields.doc: The tasks, in the order they were typed.

fields.name: filter
fields.doc: Which tasks are shown: all, active, or completed.

inits.name: example
inits.doc: The TodoMVC sample list, one item already done.
